name: salem-word
description: Salem Word - Bible reading and devotional app for House of Salem Church, Sri Lanka

scripts.setup: npm install && npm run sync-shared && npm --prefix apps/mobile install && npm --prefix apps/admin install
scripts.test: npm run test:shared && npm run test:i18n && npm run test:db
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix apps/mobile run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/admin run typecheck
